CasterDef.description:
What a caster casts and how it fights: it casts each spell at its target whenever the spell is ready and the
target is in range and in sight, in the listed order, and backs away from a target nearer than
``keep_distance``.

keep_distance.description: It backs away from a target nearer than this many blocks; 0 never backs away.
keep_distance.title: Keep Distance

spells.description: Its spells, by id (realmforge:<id>), most important first. Each targets an enemy.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

spells.title: Spells

DropCountDef.description: How many of the item one drop gives: a whole number from ``min`` to ``max``, each as likely.
DropCountDef.title: DropCountDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

MobAttributesDef.description: The mob's vanilla attributes at level 1; its level scales health, armor and damage (architecture 14.1).

attack_damage.description: Damage of a melee hit, in health points.
attack_damage.title: Attack Damage

follow_range.description: How far in blocks it notices a player and follows its target.
follow_range.title: Follow Range

knockback_resistance_percent.description: The share of knockback it shrugs off, 0 to 100.
knockback_resistance_percent.title: Knockback Resistance Percent

movement_speed.description: Vanilla's movement speed: a zombie's is 0.23.
movement_speed.title: Movement Speed

MobDropDef.description:
One item the mob may drop when it dies: rolled on its own, so drops never crowd each other out. Every drop is
worth having (the vision: no trash loot).

chance_percent.description: The chance it drops at all, in percent: 100 by default.
chance_percent.title: Chance Percent

count.description: How many: from min to max, 1 by default.

The sounds it makes, by sound event id; a sound left out is vanilla's for hostile mobs (none for ambient
and the step sound of the block it walks on).

description:
A custom mob, ``realmforge:<id>``: an entity type of one archetype with its data. Its name is the entity
type's translation, ``entity.realmforge.<id>``, shown in Neat's card, Jade's tooltip and death messages.

archetype.description: melee: walks up to its target and hits it; caster: casts its spells and keeps its distance.
archetype.title: Archetype

caster.description: A caster's spells; only for archetype caster.

color.description: Main colour of its placeholder texture, "#RRGGBB".
color.title: Color

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

idle.description: stroll: wanders while it has no target; guard: stands at the spot where it spawned and walks back to it once it loses its target.
idle.title: Idle

loot.description: What it may drop when it dies.
loot.title: Loot

name.description: The mob's name, Title Case (lore style guide).
